prompt:
Design a radical, inventive, high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE concept for a Russian online psychology conference. This is a functioning-looking website with legible navigation, headline, date and registration CTA, NOT a poster, not a moodboard, not a browser in a frame. Show edge-to-edge website, first screen plus a glimpse of the next scene below, wide 4:3 canvas. An experimental cultural-event digital studio made this: surprise, controlled chaos, oversized photographic cutouts, daring scale and spatial storytelling. No familiar SaaS layout, no neat equal cards, no left-copy/right-portrait template, no carousel or fan of photo cards, no large rounded-corner section containers, no graph paper, no grid background, no notebooks or school supplies, no generic blobs or sparkles, no gradient typography. Russian typography: modern Cyrillic sans serif with personality, medium weight, sentence case, NOT uppercase except АСП. Crisp full headline EXACTLY: «Как превратить знания из вуза в первую практику». Keep the ENTIRE phrase readable, no obscured letters, no cropped words, no swapped words. Exact small content: «Студенческая конференция 2.0», «21 ноября 2026 · онлайн», «Участие бесплатно». Exact CTA: «Зарегистрироваться бесплатно». Header logo АСП; links «Программа», «Спикеры», «Участие». Small gift line «Карта психологических подходов — после регистрации». Palette: off-white, almost-black violet #292338, rich purple #7954D4, pale lilac. Design is playful and editorial, not corporate or school-themed. Don't invent endorsements, speaker names or statistics. Composition itself communicates moving from theory to working with clients. All images illustrative, professionally art-directed, physically convincing.
Concept «Сменить место». The dominant image is a surreal but photo-real sculptural composition of REAL CHAIRS, breaking across the central vertical flow of the webpage. In the upper left quarter a cropped diagonal bank of small charcoal lecture-theatre seats in 3 receding rows, camera almost overhead; one rich purple upholstered armchair has escaped from the rows and floats much larger near center, casting a believable soft directional shadow onto the warm white page. Lower right a second cream upholstered therapy armchair faces the purple one across a small side table. They form a two-person conversation. The objects are isolated photographic cutouts on the actual page ground, NOT boxed photos, not chairs arranged as product cards. The website type inhabits their negative space: main headline massive but readable across upper-middle area in three ragged lines, full sentence spanning the width, chairs flow above and diagonally below it rather than a symmetrical split. Unexpected crop, 3 different scales, a strong diagonal; clever collision and breathing room. Short editorial line near lecture seats «Сначала вы слушаете», near consultation chairs «Потом — слушают вас». Place CTA and date at bottom-left of first screen in an obvious clean UI cluster, black/violet button. A sharp dark purple section enters from bottom, with white title «Практика начинается с разговора» and compact three text links «С чего начать», «Выбор метода», «Путь с нуля». Typography and chairs must feel like one authored interactive scene, not illustration plus marketing sidebar. Whole composition smart, bold, odd, premium, no symmetry. Render razor-sharp Russian text.
critique: Poor Russian text and weak composition. Replaced by built-in image generation.
